_about: Written at stage 0.5 from setup.json (the smallest render card) and the film's machine-time budget; one per study, versioned. scene_weight.py --budget checks the scene keys at the end of stages 2, 3, 4, 5 and 10; the time keys are checked by the stage 5 convergence record and the stage 10 estimate. Meanings, derivations and which values are measured or judgement: references/scene-optimisation.md section 0. Keys starting with _ are notes.
noise_target: render residual <= the film grain sigma in the darkest third of the frame, display domain, 1:1, no denoiser
_card_gb: smallest card that will render finals (setup.json); 4 cards add speed, not memory
_max_vram_share: scene_weight's estimate and the renderer's own figure, as a share of card_gb (judgement)
_hero_collections: exempt from the per-object and per-image lines: the product, its prints and labels; the world's images (the HDRI) are exempt whenever this key is present
_max_image_px: longest side of any non-hero image: set textures capped at load
_max_image_gb: about card_gb x max_vram_share - geometry estimate - frame buffers and passes (1-2 GB at 1080p)
_max_sampled_mesh_emitters: the practicals meant to light; every other glowing prop is out of light sampling
_s_per_frame_by_state: renderer seconds per 1080p frame at the noise target with the passes on, on the production node; frame-weighted they fit machine_hours with the fixed costs
_film_frames: planned frames including handles and the end hold
